claim: Picks the one or two elements that keep moving over an otherwise frozen drawing: a blink, a hair sway, a curl of steam. This is literally what limited animation is, and choosing the right element is what stops a held cut reading as a still image.
not_visual: The variable selects which existing element animates, not whether it is present. Tagging 'steam' in a still adds steam to the frame instead of showing that the steam is the moving part.
